sn45.11:1.3: namhi kenaci upasaṅkamitabbo aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanīhārakenāti.
sn45.11:1.4: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paṭissutvā. nāssudha koci bhagavantaṃ upasaṅkamati aññatra ekena piṇḍapātanīhārakena.
sn45.11:2.1: atha kho bhagavā tassa aḍḍhamāsassa accayena paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhito bhikkhū āmantesi
sn45.11:2.2: yena svāhaṃ bhikkhave vihārena paṭhamābhisambuddho viharāmi tassa padesena vihāsiṃ
sn45.11:2.11: chando ca avūpasanto hoti vitakkā ca avūpasantā honti saññā ca avūpasantā hoti tappaccayāpi vedayitaṃ
sn45.11:2.12: chando ca vūpasanto hoti vitakkā ca vūpasantā honti saññā ca vūpasantā hoti tappaccayāpi vedayitaṃ
